summary.headline: Front carry remains intact, but September/November tail convexity was rebuilt aggressively
key_points: Signed VIX delta is +$47.626M; even excluding the dominant Sep/Nov 35C tail package the remainder stays +$8.626M.
September 35C buying of ~65,077 contracts nearly mirrors Friday's observed sale of ~65,071, materially neutralizing the prior September tail supply.
A new November 35C tail book of 48,807 contracts was bought for $5.8M.
August remains comparatively benign with body/downside risk sold; September body 18-20 is still sold but now offset by synthetic-long and call reloading.
The carried October 20/30 stress hedge has no obvious comparable unwind in the Aug 10 tape; prior October 35C supply also remains largely intact.
summary.daily_note: Базовый front-carry режим сохраняется, но рынок перестал уверенно продавать deferred tail: тело волатильности продают, moderate stress страхуют, а September/November 35C снова получают крупный bid.

leave_one_out.comment: Largest single print is November 35C buy; excluding it leaves the tape materially long VIX delta.
